Messages.Author: OliverMasterPhase
Messages.Body:
TITTLE MUST BE: PSYCHE VS ASHES TO ASHES
Quick question: does psyche prevent an opposing vampire from going to torpor using Ashes to Ashes?

Spanish: Psyche evita que un vampiro oponente se vaya a torpor al usar Ashes to Ashes?

Thanks!

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
Can you please provide more details to your question, I fail to understand what exactly you want to know. Psyche! can only be played if both combatants are still ready i.e. no one can be going to torpor because of wounds at least for it to be playable.

Psyche!

Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Celerity
Press.
Only usable at the end of a round when both combatants are still ready and combat is about to end. After this round, begin another combat with the opposing minion.

Dust to Dust

Ashes to Ashes

Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Thanatosis/Fortitude
Only usable by a vampire being burned; he or she is sent into torpor instead.
Prevent all damage. This vampire unlocks and goes to torpor (ending combat).
As  above, and this vampire gains 2 blood from the blood bank.

Messages.Author: OliverMasterPhase
Messages.Body:
Sure. My mistake I mean: Ashes to Ashes.
I.E: In combat against a Samedi. They play Ashes to Ashes (untaps and goes to torpor). Can I (or the same Samedi) play a Psyche! to restart a combat? preventing the Samedi to go to torpor.

Similar to what happen with Rötschreck and then a Psyche! prevents the acting vampire from going to torpor.

If not, I really would like to understand the main difference between Ashes to Ashes Scenario vs Rötschreck scenario,

Thanks!

Messages.Author: OliverMasterPhase
Messages.Body: CEL Is played during combat, when combat is about to end. It must be played after the presses are handled and can be played if the round ends prematurely. [RTR 20030519][PIB 20111202]

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Please quote the cards from the  official cardtexts

Name: Ashes to Ashes
[BL:R2, LoB:R]
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Thanatosis/Fortitude
[for] Only usable by a vampire being burned; he or she is sent into torpor instead.
[thn] Prevent all damage. This vampire unlocks and goes to torpor (ending combat).
[THN] As [thn] above, and this vampire gains 2 blood from the blood bank.

Name: Psyche!
[Jyhad:U, VTES:U, FN:PA2, CE:U/PB, KMW:PAl2, Third:U, KoT:U/PB3/PT3]
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Celerity
[cel] Press.
[CEL] Only usable at the end of a round when both combatants are still ready and combat is about to end. After this round, begin another combat with the opposing minion.

Ashes to Ashes sends the vampire to torpor, which in turn ends combat.
Psyche! cannot be played to prevent the vampire from going to torpor and requires the two vampires to be ready at the end of the combat, which is not the case here.
